title: We handle every stage, from the pond to the pallet
intro: We work to one agreed specification at each step, and we run our own refrigerated trucks, logistics and cold stores.

farming.title: Farming and sourcing
farming.text: Our own farms, plus fish we buy from suppliers.

harvest.title: Harvest
harvest.text: Netted and taken to our plant in Motobas.

packing.title: Washing, icing and packing
packing.text: Washed, graded by weight and packed whole on ice.

inspection.title: Inspection
inspection.text: Checked against the agreed specification before the boxes are closed.

export.title: Export
export.text: Our own refrigerated trucks, then air or road freight.
